en.title: DAA 4.7.2: annual reserve audit may end 4 months after year end, but its result is due 4 weeks after the 'reference date of the valuation'
en.summary: DAA 4.7.2(1) requires the issuer to "mandate an independent third party audit of the reserve assets annually but not later than four months after the close of its financial year"; 4.7.2(2) requires the result to be provided "at the latest within 4 weeks of the reference date of the valuation". "Reference date of the valuation" is not defined, and (1) does not say whether the four months apply to commissioning or to completing the audit. If the reference date is the financial-year end, the result could be due before the audit has to be done.
en.correction: Please define the reference date of the valuation and clarify whether the four-month period concerns commissioning or completing the audit.

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities_V5 (with amendments as of 7 December 2025, which commence on 1 January 2026)
quotes.text: Issuer of a Fiat stablecoin or Commodity stablecoin must mandate an independent third party audit of the reserve assets annually but not later than four months after the close of its financial year.

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities_V5 (with amendments as of 7 December 2025, which commence on 1 January 2026)
quotes.text: The result of the audit conducted under (1) must be provided to the AFSA without delay, at the latest within 4 weeks of the reference date of the valuation.
